name: Mehdi Ziazi
biography: Mehdi Ziazi is a hacker and cybersecurity student at ETH Zurich and an incoming PhD student at CISPA focused on aerospace security and cyber-physical systems. Their recent work in aviation security explores novel attack paths against aircraft systems and their real-world impact, approached with curiosity, persistence, and a bit of stubbornness.
